paite: Israel kumpipa Jeroboam kum sawmnih-le-sagih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Amaziah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Uzziah / (2 Kro 26.1-23)
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawm-le-guk a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nih alal a; anu min Jekoliah, Jerusalem mi ahi.
english: He was sixteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

paite: Apa Amaziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

paite: Himahleh mun sangte lakmang ahi tuan kei. Mun sangte ah mite kithoih lailai in, gimlim ahal lai uhi.
english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

paite: TOUPA'N kumpipa agawt a, huchi in asih ni pha in aphak a, inn tuam ah atengta hi. Kumpipa tapa Jotham in agam ua mite vai hawmsak in inkuan tung a heutu in a-om hi.
english: Yahweh struck the king, so that he was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house. Jotham, the king’s son, was over the household, judging the people of the land.

paite: Huchi in Azariah tanchin dangte athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Azariah bel api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a; api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; huchi in asik in atapa Jotham alalta hi.
english: Azariah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in David’s city; and Jotham his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmthum-le-giat alal kum in Jeroboam tapa Zakariah Israelte tung ah Samaria ah kha guk alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Zakariah
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah the son of Jeroboam reigned over Israel in Samaria six months.

paite: Apute hih mah bang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil ahihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Jabesh tapa Shallum in aguk in thah asawm a, mipite ma ah asual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people and killed him, and reigned in his place.

paite: Huchi in Zakariah tanchin dangte bel ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Huai bel ToUPA'N Jehu kiang a, "Na tapate suan lina tan in Israelte laltutphah ah atu ding uh," chih thu agen hi. Huchi in huai bang geih ahong hita hi.
english: This was Yahweh’s word which he spoke to Jehu, saying, “Your sons to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.” So it came to pass.

paite: Judah kumpipa Uzziah kum sawmthum-le-kua alal kum in Jabesh tapa Shallum alal pan a; Samaria ah kha khat sung alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Shallum
english: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned for a month in Samaria.

paite: Tirzah a pan Gadi tapa Menahem ahohtou a, Samaria ah ahoh a, Samaria ah Jabesh tapa Shallum asual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
english: Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, came to Samaria, struck Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, killed him, and reigned in his place.

paite: Huchi in Shallum tanchin dangte, aguksawmna thute ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Menahem in Tirzah a pan Tiphsah leh asung a om tengteng leh agamte asual a; amah a dia akihon louh ziak un asual a; huai ah naupai lai numei tengteng apikkek hi.
english: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.

paite: Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmthum-le-kua alal kum in Gadi tapa Menahem Israelte tung ah alal pan a, Samaria ah kum sawm alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Menahem
english: In the thirty ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem the son of Gadi began to reign over Israel for ten years in Samaria.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna in adamsung apaisan kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Assuria kumpipa Pul in agam ahong sual a; gam aneihkippih theihna ding in Menahem in Pul dangka talent sangkhat apia hi.
english: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

paite: Menahem in Assuria kumpipa piak ding in Israel mi nei zou tengteng lak ah dangka shekel sawmnga chiat akhon a; huchi in Assuria kumpipa apai nawn a, huai gam ah ataam nilouh kei hi.
english: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn’t stay there in the land.

paite: Menahem tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Menahem api-le-pute kiang ah ihmuta a; asik in atapa Pekahiah alal hi.
english: Menahem slept with his fathers, and Pekahiah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmnga alal kum in Israelte tung ah Samaria ah Menahem tapa Pekahiah alal pan a, kum nih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Pekahiah
english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Israel in Samaria for two years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei hi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Asepaih heutu Remaliah tapa Pekah in amah aguksawm a, Samaria a kumpipa' inn a kulh ah Argob toh, Arieh toh athatta a; akiang ah Gilead mi sawmnga toh; huchi in Pekahiah athat a, asik in alalta hi.
english: Pekah the son of Remaliah, his captain, conspired against him and attacked him in Samaria, in the fortress of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh; and with him were fifty men of the Gileadites. He killed him, and reigned in his place.

paite: Huchi in Pekahiah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Judah kumpipa Azariah kum sawmnga-le-nih alal kum in Remaliah tapa Pekah Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawmnih alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Pekah
english: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil hihkhialsak, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate apaisan kei.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

paite: Israel kumpipa Pekah lal lai in Assuria kumpipa Tiglath-pileser in Ijon, Abel-beth-maakah, Janoah, Kadesh, Hazor, Gilead leh Galili gamte leh Naphtali gam tengteng ala a, Assuria gam ah sal in api hi.
english: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali; and he carried them captive to Assyria.

paite: Elah tapa Hoshea in Remaliah tapa Pekah aguksawm a, asual a, athat a, Uzziah tapa Jotham kum sawmnih alal kum in asik in alalta hi.
english: Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, attacked him, killed him, and reigned in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

paite: Huchi in Pekah tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng, ngai dih, Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah atuang hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

paite: Israel kumpipa Remaliah tapa Pekah kum nih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Uzziah tapa Jotham alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jotham / (2 Kro 27.1-9)
english: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-guk alal a; anu min Jerusha, Zadok tanu ahi.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerusha the daughter of Zadok.

paite: Apa Uzziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih ahih hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes. He did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

paite: Himahleh mun sangte hihmang ahi tuan kei; mun sangte ah mite'n kithoih in, gimlim ahal lai uhi. TOUPA' inn kongpi saknungzaw abawlhoih hi.
english: However the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places. He built the upper gate of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in Jotham tanchin dangte, athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huai lai in Siria kumpipa Rezin leh Remulia tapa Pekah Judate sual ding in TOUPA'N asawl pan hi.
english: In those days, Yahweh began to send Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah against Judah.

paite: Jotham api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-pute lak ah apu David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahaz alalta hi.
english: Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in his father David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
